newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Five killed in railway explosion near Chechnya.
newsitem.headline: Five killed in railway explosion near Chechnya.

text.p: Five rail workers were killed and two were injured in an explosion on a railway track in Dagestan, just over the border from the breakaway Chechnya region on Friday, the Dagestan interior ministry said.
"We think it might have been an explosive device," a ministry official said, adding that security services were trying to establish the cause of the blast.
He said traffic on the railway line was not affected.

Officials in Chechnya said on Friday they were stepping up security before a presidential election due to take place on Monday. But local interior minister Kazbek Makhashev said disruption to the polls could not be ruled out.
"It is difficult to exclude provocations by forces who want to destabilise the situation in the republic," he said.
The Dagestan region borders Chechnya to the east.
